# Why indoor golf in Johannesburg is the next big thing

Indoor golf venues have quietly transformed how South Africans practise. Swing Shack's two TrackMan simulators give you the same launch-monitor data the pros use, in the middle of Melrose Arch, rain or shine.

## What indoor golf actually is

Indoor golf means climate-controlled hitting bays with launch monitors like TrackMan. You see real ball flight, club path, face angle, spin, smash factor — every shot, captured.

## Why JHB golfers are switching

- Weatherproof year-round play
- Same TrackMan data the pros use
- Book by the hour, no membership lock-in
- Coaching, fitting, and practice all in one bay

If you've been waiting for a reason to get your swing back in shape, this is it. Book a bay. Bring your bag. Get the data.
